regime_context: The TSX detector shows Big Banks as the dominant narrative with high durability (0.78) and broad participation, but crowded. 12 of 16 themes are eligible, indicating a dispersed, not one-narrative, market. The absolute trend gate is validated for drawdown control, but cross-sectional momentum and rotation timing have no forward edge. A geopolitically heavy macro backdrop with half of recent headlines unscheduled adds uncertainty.
emerging_watch: Watch Base Metals & Copper: if durability_bar rises above 0.6 and breadth exceeds 0.5 within 10 trading days, the challenger could threaten leadership. Kill if Big Banks maintains rank 1 and eligibility through that window.

theses.subject: Big Banks
theses.thesis: Big Banks hold the leading narrative with strong durability and broad participation. The absolute trend gate, validated for risk control, makes an overweight lean a risk-managed expression of the prevailing theme despite crowding.
evidence: gate_helps: true (absolute trend gate reduces drawdowns)
theses.dissent: Crowded positioning (crowding_z 1.52) and a geopolitically driven macro backdrop with high unscheduled surprise (0.5) could trigger sharp liquidation; the mixed Hurst tag suggests potential mean reversion.

falsifier.text: Big Banks loses eligibility (trend gate fails) or durability_bar falls below 0.6.

theses.subject: Oil & Gas Producers
theses.thesis: Oil & Gas Producers exhibit deeply negative momentum, low durability, and very narrow breadth, all on a theme absent from dominant macro narratives. Underweighting respects trend discipline and the weak coincidence of supporting macro catalysts.
evidence: macro_narrative: only 1/12 recent mentions for industrial_policy, no explicit energy narrative
theses.dissent: Eligibility shows the absolute trend gate has not failed; commodity sectors can reprice violently on unscheduled geopolitical news, and low crowding removes reflexivity risk.

falsifier.text: Oil & Gas Producers score rises above -0.5 and durability exceeds 0.6, or a supply-shock macro narrative becomes one of the dominant themes.

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
